title: Blood Price
body:
# Blood Price
**Pay with blood for power.**

## Description
**BloodPrice -** is a mod that adds a system of abilities activated by spending HP. Risk vs reward: the more health you sacrifice, the stronger you become.

## Abilities
- Blood Dash (R) - instant dash 8 blocks forward. Cost: 2 ❤
- Life Strike (Z) - next attack deals x3 damage. Cost: 1.5 ❤
- Crimson Shield (G) - 5 seconds of invulnerability. Cost: 4 ❤
- Soul Swap (V) - teleport to nearest mob within 15 blocks. Cost: 2.5 ❤
- Blood Heal (B) - heals allies for 3 ❤ within 10 blocks. Cost: 4 ❤
## Artifacts
Craftable items with passive effects while in inventory:

- Blood Pendant - reduces ability cost by 20%
- Crimson Ring - reduces cooldowns by 25%
- Heart Stone - +2 max HP

## Configuration
Fully configurable via config file:

- Cost of each ability
- Cooldown durations
- Enable/disable individual abilities
- Artifact parameters
